capabilities: Create notes from filename templates via command palette or ribbon icon
Preview the generated filename live before creating the note
Insert date/time placeholders, UUIDs, short IDs, and hashes into filenames
Generate Unix timestamps and seconds-since-midnight in bases 2-36
Use auto-incrementing counters and system variables (hostname, username)
disambiguation: Not a note-content templating tool; it only generates filenames, with note content entered separately.
problem: Obsidian's note creation offers no templated filenames, so users must type date stamps, IDs, or sequential names by hand.
summary: Filename template plugin that creates notes with templated names using date/time formats, random strings, counters, and custom base numbering.
